of {{< var build.date >}} (rendered {{< var build.rendered >}}) by the

## What is verified, and where

- **The numerical core** (`core/`, the Julia package `NestedMHD`) has a validation suite,
  `core/test/runtests.jl`, which the publish workflow runs on every push before rendering. Every
  claim in the text that rests on one of its tests carries a ✓ badge linking to the `@testset`.
- **Superscript ⟨name⟩ marks** link to the line of `core/src` where the function next to an equation
  is defined.
- **Datasets** behind the widgets and the laboratory are `app/data/*.json`, written by
  `core/bench/run_experiments.jl`, `core/bench/run_mach10.jl` and `core/bench/combine_ensemble.jl`. Each file records when, on which CPU and with how many threads it
  was produced. They are committed, not regenerated in CI.
- **Citations** were checked against NASA ADS; each entry carries its bibcode and DOI.

## What is *not* verified

- No GPU backend has been compiled or run. The kernels are portable by construction, but GPU
  correctness and performance are untested (@sec-roadmap).
- Driven Mach-10 turbulence has been run only in 2-D (@sec-ergo-run), with $\beta = 200$, on CPUs. It
  needed a positivity guard on refluxing (@sec-reflux-guard), which gives up exact conservation in
  the cells where it acts. No 3-D driven run has been made.
- In those 2-D runs, the mean $v_x$ in the central region is negative in all eight members of the ensemble,
  and we have not explained it (@sec-ergo-ensemble).
- Refinement is static. There is no regridding, and only one child per level is supported.

## Lineage

- [yipihey/GLMMHDTurb](https://github.com/yipihey/GLMMHDTurb): source of the pointwise physics and of
  the performance practice (@sec-kept).
- [Solaceonx/GLMMHDTurb, `sweep-fixes`](https://github.com/Solaceonx/GLMMHDTurb/tree/sweep-fixes):
  the CT fix (full slope, three-direction predictor, Gardiner–Stone EMFs), the HLLD guard, and $c_h$
  from the CFL step.
- `cascade_gravity` (Rust): the subcycled cascade MHD driver, whose refluxing and EMF-restriction
  design was carried over, and whose first-order time accuracy at refinement boundaries is removed here.

## How to cite

The repository carries a `CITATION.cff`; GitHub shows it as "Cite this repository". Until a DOI is
minted, cite the repository and the commit above.

## Sharing a view of the laboratory

Every state of the laboratory is encoded in the address bar (the part after `#`), so copying the URL
shares the exact view. The *copy link* button does this. Plots download as SVG or CSV from their
toolbars.

## Annotating and discussing

Pages carry the Hypothesis sidebar: select any passage to annotate it. Corrections are welcome as
issues; every page has an *Edit this page* link.
